title: Physics Ping Pong game (VERY DIFFICULT)
author: Longjumping_Form9922
selftext:
Incredibly sorry for the double post. This one showcases what some practice looks like.  
  
I've always wanted a true to life mouse and keyboard ping pong game... there has only really been one good one on VR, this is not VR. and my god its hard. If you've played any physics sports games, youll find this just as difficult as any of them. it takes time, but i think this game has an infinite skill ceiling, and it is so rewarding when you hit volleys

Controls  
W and S move on the Y axis, up and down,  
Left click locks your forehand or backhand  
Scroll wheel is paddle tilt  


You can play it here - [https://www.slopwithfrens.com/g/20748d9d-b949-452b-a4c8-d4c734df848b](https://www.slopwithfrens.com/g/20748d9d-b949-452b-a4c8-d4c734df848b)
